samples.summary: New Quote / Code block / Foldout toolbar buttons have no test that they are rendered and wired to the editor API
samples.evidence: The diff adds three TooltipButtons calling editor.toggleQuote() / insertCodeBlock() / insertFoldout(). There is no test file for the notes toolbar anywhere: `packages/frontend/tests/app/notes/**` does not exist, and grep for insertFoldout|toggleQuote|insertCodeBlock across the repo matches only packages/notes/src/view/{commands,editor,commands.test,preview.test}.ts. By contrast slides/docs toolbars have tests under packages/frontend/tests/app/slides/toolbar/*. So a mis-wired handler (e.g. Quote button calling insertCodeBlock, or the buttons rendered outside the editing branch) would ship green: the command unit tests call the functions directly, never through the button.

samples.summary: insertCodeBlock is only tested at a line start; the mid-line prefix branch and multi-line selections are uncovered
samples.evidence: Both new tests (commands.test.ts:110 `mount('code', 0, 4)` and :119 `mount('', 0)`) start at offset 0, so `prefix` is always ''. The `from === line.from ? '' : '\n'` branch at commands.ts:244 is never exercised, and neither is a selection that leaves trailing text on the same line after `to` (which would end up appended after the closing fence) nor a multi-line selection. The foldout got an analogous 'breaks out of the current line' test; the code block did not.

samples.summary: toggleQuote's unquote path is only tested against markers at column 0; QUOTE_RE also eats leading indentation, and blank lines in the range are untested
samples.evidence: QUOTE_RE = /^\s*>\s?/ matches leading whitespace, so unquoting `  > text` deletes the indentation too. The three new tests (commands.test.ts:127, :137, :150) all use unindented lines and never include a blank line inside the selected range (a blank line makes `quoted` false, so an all-quoted block containing one empty line would be re-quoted instead of unquoted). Neither behaviour has any assertion.

samples.summary: insertFoldout is never tested with a non-empty selection
samples.evidence: insertFoldout uses `state.selection.main.head` and dispatches `changes: { from: pos, insert }` — it inserts at the caret without replacing a selection, so invoking it with text selected splices the skeleton into the middle of the selected text at the head end. Both new tests (commands.test.ts:80 and :93) use a collapsed caret (`mount('',0)`, `mount('text',4)`), so this path has no coverage even though the toolbar button can be pressed with a selection.

samples.summary: The two CSS acceptance criteria (flat foldout, indented body) have no automated coverage
samples.evidence: The task doc docs/tasks/active/20260822-notes-foldout-toolbar-todo.md:16-19 lists 'loses background/borders' and 'content rendered indented' as acceptance criteria. Grep across packages/frontend for note-details finds only the stylesheet itself and its @import in src/index.css — no unit or visual test references .note-details/.note-summary, and packages/notes/src/view/preview.test.ts only asserts DOM class names, never computed style. A regression in the indentation rule or a reintroduced border would go unnoticed. (CSS is not unit-tested elsewhere in this repo either, hence minor.)

samples.summary: 'inserts foldout tags flush left' is redundant: it re-checks a subset of a string already asserted exactly two tests above
samples.evidence:
commands.test.ts:80-91 already asserts the full document for `mount('', 0)` equals '<details>
<summary></summary>

</details>
'. The test at :101 runs the identical input and only asserts each line equals its trimStart() — a property implied by the earlier exact-equality assertion, so it can never fail independently. The real cross-check for 'not indented code' is the preview test (preview.test.ts) which asserts no <pre>; this one adds no signal.
